newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania net average wage 1.5 pct up in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Romania net average wage 1.5 pct up in Nov.

text.p: Romania's November average monthly net wage rose 1.5 percent from October, an increase well below November's 5.8-percent inflation, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
It said purchasing power slipped by 4.1 percent in November from the previous month but was up 2.3 percent year-on-year.
The CNS report said November's purchasing power was 72.3 percent of the 1990 level.
Employees in the financial sector had the highest net wage of 850,648 lei on average in November. Workers in the health and social security sectors had the lowest pay of 274,640 lei.
Romania employed 5.715 million people at end-November, 47,200 less than the previous month.
